Japan's **Anthropic Usage Index is 1.91** (period 2026-05-01). That puts it 32nd of the 121 countries covered.

The index is a country's share of Claude usage divided by its share of the world's working-age population. At 1.0, usage matches what population alone would predict, and 1.0 is also the global average. At 1.91, Japan uses Claude about 91% more than its population size would suggest.

For context against the global average:
- **Use case:** 47% work, 47% personal and 6% coursework. Globally it's 43%, 40% and 16%.
- **Augmentation vs. automation:** 53% of conversations augment the person's work and 47% automate it. Globally it's 51% and 49%.

Source and methodology: https://www.anthropic.com/economic-index
